payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-18: the soak, rollback rehearsal and SHA-bound tenancy dispatch are now planned with exact commands, costs, stop conditions and evidence in docs/operator-rehearsal-plan.md steps 3 and 4 (not yet run; owner approval needed). The nightly harness still fails under a green scheduled run (see #F9HZEG). PRIOR DETAIL: Combined test harness code and automated pinned failure routing merged in PR #3087 (7941a7b36f); live staging run pending. PRIOR DETAIL (restored 2026-10-09, an earlier update replaced it wholesale): UPDATE 2026-09-26 (read-only GitHub Actions read, no provider access): the nightly staging-tenancy.yml harness failed on every scheduled run checked (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-25) at its deployment-identity step: staging reported 0b858bb3a (the PR #3030 merge) while the run checked out newer main commits. Staging is not redeployed on pushes to main, so the SHA-bound harness cannot pass on a schedule until staging tracks main or is redeployed before each run. A failing main run now opens a pinned, assigned GitHub issue (label staging-tenancy-failure; branch claude/urgent-ledger-fixes-8dnh5c). The wider harness (CME and On Call writes, evidence, export, content; PR #3065) has not yet run on staging. Next action: owner decides whether staging should auto-deploy from main (Railway setting) or be redeployed before a dispatched run. PRIOR DETAIL: Staging migration parity is closed. Run SHA-bound tenancy evidence, transition the same candidate image from the offline tenancy profile to the authenticated auto-provider load profile, execute the staging soak, and rehearse rollback. Retain checkout/deployed SHA, latency, error, throttling, authentication, cleanup, and rollback evidence. Stop on unsafe data, identity mismatch, or an unowned rollback decision. 2026-11-05 backend audit (F10, F11, V11), local source33f6478: The local small fixtures/build timings are not representative capacity/cost proof. Existing #057 staging deployment alignment/soak/rollback remains pending. Next: Append tested-boundary gaps to #057 and reuse #H69FNZ for hydration attribution; on approved isolated candidate disclose synthetic dataset, concurrency, caches, resource/cost caps and sampling before bounded measurements. Acceptance: Meaningful latency/error distributions/sample counts; no silent lost writes, starvation or unbounded fanout/retries/cancellation work; old/new fleet rollback compatible and observed. Distinguish public metadata/free setup from billable provider work. Suggested owner: Delivery + performance owner + operator. No merge, deployment, live migration, provider spending or specialist approval is granted by logging this task.
